claims.text: The public procedure index presents multiple route leads: Sakala manual submission at sub-division office, Suvarna Paravanige and CC/OC at zonal office, and plan sanction at head office; which applies is property/category-specific.
The BPAS public description routes online application/file creation through a BBMP-registered architect and identifies the architect/applicant as the external user.
claims.notes: Dated description; current GBA professional route unknown.

claims.text: The BPAS sequence names pre-DCR CAD plan, applicable NOCs, sale deed and Khata certificate as upload examples before scrutiny; exact documents depend on the proposal.
The dated BPAS workflow describes inward document checking, automated DCR scrutiny, return/correction for gaps, then AE/ADTP site inspection when documents are correct.
claims.notes: No scrutiny, return or inspection observed.

claims.text: The dated BPAS workflow says licence fee is calculated by built-up area and that approval produces an online PDF licence; larger general proposals add chief engineer/joint commissioner stages.
claims.notes: No fee, payment, authority decision or PDF output exists.

claims.text: The official public submission page exposes a BPAS login link, so this public-only pass stops before architect/applicant session entry.
